# optionledger.flex_section_status r1

optionledger.flex_section_status r1: whether one section was in the statement of one alias in one fetch, with its row count and the rows refused; insert only. No account number is stored.

| column | type | nullable | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| fetch_id | string | no | Identifier of the fetch. |
| alias | string | no | Account alias of the statement, the label mapped by the allow-list. |
| section | string | no | Row element name of the section in the Flex statement, for example CashTransaction; a pattern, so a later section needs no schema change. |
| state | enum(present, absent) | no | present: the statement has the section; absent: the Flex query lacks it. |
| row_count | integer | no | Rows of the section stored or found unchanged; 0 when absent. |
| rows_refused | integer | no | Rows refused for a missing key attribute or a duplicate key. |
| recorded_at | string (date-time) | no | Instant the status was recorded, UTC. |

Primary key: (fetch_id, alias, section)
